errors.text_span: Категориите са подредени във възходящ ред спрямо процентните стойности
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories on the vertical axis are sorted in ascending order of their percentage values. The values, from top to bottom, are 14.1%, 53.7%, 16.1%, 10.1%, 28.9%, 15.4%, 20.8%, and 6.0%. This sequence is not sorted in any particular order.
